title: Dinner Lady Melon Twist Short Fill
description: You’re twisting my melon, man… This totally tropical tincture from Dinner Lady’s brand-new Fruits range is a twisted medley of creamy melon and fresh watermelon with a tangy gild of succulent kiwi. Light, bright and endlessly-refreshing, this melon mixture is as close as it gets to a bottled ray of sunshine and promises sweetly-scented clouds which are fit to burst with enticing, exotic flavour. The high-VG base of Melon Twist is ideal for sub ohm vaping and is supplied in a 50ml bottle with space for a 10ml nicotine shot of your choice. This allows you to customise your vape to suit your individual needs and lets you combine sweet satisfaction with moreish, melon-y madness.
